title: Make infrastructure access explicit and least-privileged
summary: Infrastructure and cloud configuration should grant only the specific identities, actions, resources, networks, and exposure required for the intended service.
review_checks: Find wildcard permissions, public exposure, broad security groups, and default identities.
Verify each privilege has a documented workload need.
safe_tests: Evaluate configuration in a local plan or sandbox account only.
Use policy tests that assert denied access for unapproved actions.
remediation: Replace wildcards with scoped actions and resource constraints.
Use private-by-default network boundaries and separate workload identities.
